The version of the language where the last name Sylvester originates, used during the era of Fastrada's spouse Charlemagne, is Carolingian Latin, which is also referred to as Medieval Latin. This standardized form of Latin was developed during the Carolingian Renaissance and later became known as Carolingian Latin or Medieval Latin.

**Answer:** The version of the language is Carolingian Latin, later known as Medieval Latin.
